column3: So here's what I'd suggest. This part is ours, not the studies'.
One. Notice who you compare with. It tells you what you want.
Two. When it stings, ask one question. What can I learn from them?
Three. Keep a second ruler. You, a year ago.
And if comparing has you feeling worthless, please talk to someone you trust. There are free support lines in the description.
You'll probably never stop comparing. But you can choose what the comparison is for.
Tell me in the comments: who's your Goku? This is Social Ripple. See you next time.
